hero.description: We organize full, partial and specialized cargo transportation by road, sea and air routes.

services.title: Cargo transport and logistics
services.intro: When you choose TRANSGARANT GROUP services, you can be confident that our excellent team of professionals will take care of your goods to the highest standards.

items.title: Full-load transport
items.description: We deliver full loads door to door across Lithuania, Europe, the Baltic states and Scandinavia.

items.title: Partial and small-load transport
items.description: We transport smaller shipments by road and air, selecting an economical route to the recipient.

items.title: Warehousing and logistics
items.description: We provide storage, handling, transshipment and customs services in ambient and refrigerated facilities.

services.capabilitiesText: We assess every shipment and select the appropriate transport, documentation and control solution.

destinations.title: Routes across Europe
destinations.intro: From Vilnius, we organize cargo transport to the Baltic states, Scandinavia, Western, Central and Eastern Europe.
destinations.mapLabel: Interactive map of TRANSGARANT GROUP routes across Europe

about.title: A long-term partnership, not just one shipment
paragraphs: UAB TRANSGARANT GROUP is a transport and logistics company specializing in cargo transportation and freight forwarding. We organize international and domestic transport using our own vehicles and a trusted partner network.
Our goal is safe, on-time delivery, responsive communication and lasting cooperation.

finalCta.title: Need to transport cargo?
finalCta.description: Send us the route and cargo details and we will select the right transport solution.

footer.description: A transport and logistics partner for full, partial and specialized cargo across Europe.
